full_text_zh:
[P1] 长大“干什么”
兽医
[比]丽斯贝特·史蕾洁斯 文/图

[P2] 你喜欢养宠物吗？
如果你有一只宠物，你要定期让兽医帮它检查身体。
要是你的宠物生病了，兽医会努力把它治好。
要是你的宠物很健康，兽医会给你一些照顾宠物的建议。
想知道你的宠物吃什么吗？
想知道它喜欢在哪里睡觉吗？
去问问兽医吧，她什么都知道。

[P3] 兽医是给动物看病的医生。
给动物做检查时，她通常穿一件绿色的短袖工作服。
但给动物做手术时，她需要穿戴的东西可就多了，
比如一件绿色的手术服、一个医用口罩、一顶手术帽
和一双白手套。
只有穿成这样，才能确保手术环境干净卫生。
手术帽
白手套
手术服

[P4] 动物休憩的笼子

所有的工具都准备好了！
通常，用听诊器和体温计，兽医就能诊断出动物得了
什么病。这样兽医就知道是该给动物打针还是吃药。
有时，兽医会给动物拍一张X光片，看看它有没有骨折。
如果需要手术，大大的手术灯可以让兽医看得更清楚。
手术结束后，动物就可以在笼子里静静地休息啦！

听诊器
体温计
注射器
药品
手术灯
手术台
X光片

[P5] “医生，你好！你能帮我的小狗检查一下吗？
它什么也不想吃，也不怎么爱动了。”小男孩着急地说。
“或许它肚子疼。”兽医说，
“来，把它放到手术台上，让我仔细检查一下。”
兽医用体温计为小狗量完体温，又戴着听诊器为它做检查。

[P6] “我要给小狗的肚子拍一张X光片，”兽医说。
“只有知道它哪里出了问题，我才能帮助它。”
“拍X光片会疼吗？”小男孩紧张地问。
“当然不会。放心吧，它什么都感觉不到。”
兽医说完，将小狗带进了一个特殊的房间里。
拍X光片时，小狗不能乱动，所以兽医的助手要牢牢
抓紧小狗才行。“好了，它可真听话！”兽医说，
“过一会儿，X光片会被传送到电脑里，这样我就能
诊断出小狗的肚子出了什么问题。”

[P7] “快看，小狗的肚子里有个小球。”兽医对小男孩说。
“小狗肚子疼，是因为它把球吞进了肚子里。”
“那现在怎么办啊？”小男孩担心地问。
“我会给它做个小手术，把球取出来，这样它很快就会
好起来的！”

[P8] 做手术之前，兽医先要给小狗打一针麻药，
等小狗睡着，兽医就开始做手术了。
幸运的是，小狗什么都感觉不到。
通过一根小管子，小狗可以获取氧气和药物。
瞧，它睡得多香啊，说不定正梦见自己在吃美味的骨头，
或者在公园撒欢呢！
兽医把小球从小狗的肚子里取出来了，一切都很顺利。

[P9] 现在，小狗可以躺在笼子里休息啦！
这里还有其他的小动物，每个小动物都有自己的独立空间。手术后，动物们会慢慢苏醒过来，
不过它们的身体仍然很虚弱，需要留在诊所里观察
几天才能回家。

[P10] 几天后，小狗完全康复了，它终于可以和主人一起回家了！
“谢谢你，医生！”小男孩兴奋地说，“我又能和小狗
一起玩啦！”
“你的小狗真勇敢！但以后要注意，别再让它把小球
吞进肚子里了。”
兽医说着，奖励给小狗一块骨头饼干。

[P11] 这时，兽医接到一个紧急电话。
一个小女孩骑着小马想要跳过栏杆，
可是小马跳得不够高，它的后腿重重地撞到了栏杆上。
小马摔倒了，幸运的是，小女孩没有受伤。

[P12] 兽医很快就赶到了牧场。
给小马做完检查后，她用绷带将小马的后腿包扎起来。
“明天我会来给小马更换绷带，它很快就会好起来。”
兽医说。
“那太好了！”小女孩说，“谢谢你，医生！”

[P13] 几天之后，兽医又来看女孩和小马。
现在小马已经完全康复了。
小女孩特别高兴，还画了一幅画送给兽医。
“谢谢你！”兽医说，“我会把它挂在诊所的墙上。”
“咴儿咴儿——”小马也欢快地叫了起来。

能帮助小动物，是一件多么美好的事啊！
如果你也喜欢小动物，想要帮助它们，那就从现在开始
多了解它们吧！
或许长大后，你也会成为一名兽医呢！
full_text_en:
[P1] Growing Up to Be a 'What?'
Veterinarian
[Belgium] Liesbet Slegers, Text & Illustrations

[P2] Do you like keeping pets?
If you have a pet, you should have a veterinarian check it regularly.
If your pet is sick, the veterinarian will try hard to cure it.
If your pet is healthy, the veterinarian will give you some advice on how to care for it.
Do you want to know what your pet eats?
Do you want to know where it likes to sleep?
Ask the veterinarian—she knows everything.

[P3] A veterinarian is a doctor who treats animals.
When checking animals, she usually wears a short-sleeved green work uniform.
But when performing surgery on animals, she needs to wear much more,
such as a green surgical gown, a medical mask, a surgical cap,
and a pair of white gloves.
Only by dressing like this can she ensure the surgical environment is clean and hygienic.
Surgical cap
White gloves
Surgical gown

[P4] Animal resting cage

All the tools are ready!
Usually, with a stethoscope and a thermometer, a veterinarian can diagnose what illness the animal has. This way, the vet knows whether to give the animal an injection or medicine.
Sometimes, the vet will take an X-ray of the animal to check for fractures.
If surgery is needed, the big surgical lamp helps the vet see more clearly.
After surgery, the animal can rest quietly in the cage!

Stethoscope
Thermometer
Syringe
Medicines
Surgical lamp
Operating table
X-ray

[P5] "Doctor, hello! Can you check my little dog? It doesn't want to eat anything, and it's not moving much." The little boy said anxiously.
"Maybe it has a stomachache," the veterinarian said.
"Come, put it on the operating table, let me examine it carefully."
The veterinarian took the puppy's temperature with a thermometer, and then examined it with a stethoscope.

[P6] "I need to take an X-ray of the puppy's belly," the veterinarian said.
"Only when I know what's wrong inside can I help it."
"Will the X-ray hurt?" the little boy asked nervously.
"Of course not. Don't worry, it won't feel a thing."
The veterinarian then took the puppy into a special room.
During the X-ray, the puppy can't move, so the vet's assistant must hold it firmly in place. "Good boy, he's so well-behaved!" the veterinarian said.
"In a little while, the X-ray will be sent to the computer, and then I'll be able to diagnose what's wrong with the puppy's belly."

[P7] "Look, there's a little ball inside the puppy's stomach," the veterinarian said to the little boy.
"The puppy's stomach hurts because it swallowed the ball.
"What should we do now?" the little boy asked worriedly.
"I'll give it a small operation to take the ball out. Then it will feel better soon!"

[P8] Before the surgery, the veterinarian gives the puppy a shot of anesthesia.
Once the puppy is asleep, the veterinarian begins the surgery.
Luckily, the puppy feels nothing.
Through a small tube, the puppy can receive oxygen and medicine.
Look, how soundly it's sleeping—maybe it's dreaming of eating delicious bones,
or running around in the park!
The veterinarian took the small ball out of the puppy's stomach. Everything went smoothly.

[P9] Now, the puppy can rest in its cage!
There are other small animals here too, each with their own private space. After surgery, the animals will slowly wake up,
but their bodies are still very weak, so they need to stay at the clinic for observation
for a few days before going home.

[P10] A few days later, the puppy had fully recovered and could finally go home with its owner!
"Thank you, doctor!" the boy said excitedly, "I can play with my puppy again!"
"Your puppy is so brave! But be careful in the future, don't let it swallow small balls again."
The vet said, rewarding the puppy with a bone-shaped cookie.

[P11] At this moment, the veterinarian received an emergency call.
A little girl was riding a small horse and trying to jump over a fence.
But the horse didn't jump high enough, and its hind legs hit the fence hard.
The horse fell down, but luckily, the little girl was not hurt.

[P12] The veterinarian quickly arrived at the farm.
After examining the pony, she wrapped its hind legs with bandages.
"I'll come back tomorrow to change the bandages. It will be better soon," the veterinarian said.
"That's great!" the little girl said. "Thank you, doctor!"

[P13] A few days later, the veterinarian came to visit the girl and the little horse.
Now the little horse had completely recovered.
The little girl was especially happy and drew a picture to give to the veterinarian.
"Thank you!" the veterinarian said, "I'll hang it on the wall in my clinic."
"Hee-haw!" the little horse also happily called out.

Helping small animals is such a wonderful thing!
If you also love animals and want to help them, start learning more about them now!
Perhaps one day, you'll become a veterinarian too!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本的封面或标题页，显示书名《长大“干什么” 兽医》及作者信息，配有一只跳跃的小狗插图。
[P2] 本页通过文字和插图介绍了兽医的工作内容，包括为宠物做健康检查、治疗疾病和提供护理建议，并以提问的方式引导孩子思考宠物的生活习性。
[P3] 本页介绍了兽医的工作内容，说明了兽医在给动物做检查和做手术时穿着的不同，并通过插图标注了手术服、手术帽和白手套等装备，强调了手术环境的卫生要求。
[P4] 本页展示了兽医工作中使用的各种工具，包括听诊器、体温计、注射器、药品、手术灯、手术台和X光片，并说明了这些工具在诊断、治疗和手术中的用途，最后提到动物术后可在笼中休息。
[P5] 小男孩带着生病的小狗去看兽医，兽医建议进行检查，并用体温计和听诊器为小狗做初步诊断。
[P6] 兽医决定为生病的小狗拍X光片以诊断病因，向小男孩解释X光片无痛，并在助手的帮助下将小狗固定在检查台上进行拍摄，同时说明X光片将被传送到电脑用于诊断。
[P7] 兽医通过X光片发现小狗肚子里有一个球，解释小狗因吞食球而腹痛，并告诉小男孩将为其做小手术取出球，小狗很快就会好起来。
[P8] 本页描述了兽医为小狗进行手术的过程：先注射麻药使其入睡，再通过手术取出其肚子里的小球，手术顺利，小狗在麻醉中安然休息。
[P9] 手术后的小狗和其他动物被安置在各自的笼子里休息，由于身体虚弱，需要在诊所观察几天才能回家。
[P10] 小狗手术后康复，与主人一起回家，兽医奖励它一块骨头饼干，并提醒主人注意安全。
[P11] 兽医接到紧急电话，得知一个小女孩骑小马跳栏杆时，小马因跳不高而撞到栏杆摔倒，但女孩未受伤。
[P12] 兽医赶到牧场，为受伤的小马包扎后腿，并承诺次日更换绷带，小女孩对此表示感谢。
[P13] 兽医回访康复的小马和女孩，女孩送画表示感谢，兽医表示会将画挂在诊所墙上，小马也欢快地叫起来。页面最后鼓励读者关爱动物，或许未来也能成为兽医。
